name: Anthony Albanese _(In division)_ I raise a point of order, Madam Speaker. Just prior to your calling this division, there were two members on their feet: the member for Watson, who has not spoken in this debate, and the member for Mayo, who has. Bronwyn Bishop _(In division)_ He was moving the formal procedural motion. Anthony Albanese _(In division)_ How did you know that before you gave the call? You chose— Bronwyn Bishop _(In division)_ He was on his feet at the dispatch box and received the call from me. The question now is that the bill be read a second time.
question: Anthony Albanese _(In division)_ I raise a point of order, Madam Speaker.
